categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing and sales of various signal cables, connection cables, power cables, copper products, and electric vehicle (EV) charging guns. It serves industries including information technology, communications, precision machinery, consumer electronics, automotive parts, and energy technology services. The product portfolio includes high-frequency connection cables for 3C products, automotive wires, EV charging guns, and integrated systems for solar power plants, energy storage, and charging stations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital connection cable technologies, focusing on high-speed, high-frequency, and high-definition transmission cables. It emphasizes automated production processes, including automated stripping, welding, assembly, and molding equipment to improve efficiency and reduce costs. The company holds numerous patents related to cable manufacturing and EV charging cables, and complies with international standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, QC 080000, and automotive TS16949 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are world-class top ten LCD panel manufacturers and major international brands in the 3C and automotive sectors. The company targets markets for personal computers, communication networks, automotive electronics, green energy, and consumer electronics. It is expanding into new markets including solar modules, energy storage equipment, and EV charging infrastructure, aiming to diversify revenue sources and deepen customer relationships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Asia, with manufacturing facilities in Suzhou and Hubei provinces in China, and in Henan province, Vietnam. Sales are predominantly in Asia (about 89% of revenue), with other markets accounting for approximately 11%. The company is actively expanding its international footprint through overseas production bases to better serve global customers and mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing cables, connectors, and related components. It maintains vertical integration by producing key raw materials such as copper rods and precision molds internally, enhancing control over quality and supply stability. The company also engages in downstream activities by providing integrated EV charging and energy storage systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-end, high-speed digital connection cables to meet 3C industry trends, expanding new customer bases and markets, and enhancing automation in production. The company is actively transforming to enter the EV and green energy sectors by developing EV charging guns and integrated solar, storage, and charging systems. R&D investments focus on product innovation, manufacturing automation, and compliance with evolving international standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cables, connectors, and EV charging equipment. The company also derives income from integrated system solutions for solar power plants, energy storage, and charging infrastructure. Sales are conducted mainly through direct transactions with major international customers and OEM partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in the connection cable industry, competing with major global connector suppliers from Japan, the US, China, and Taiwan. Competitors include Tyco Electronics, Amphenol, Molex, Delphi, Foxconn Precision, and others. The company differentiates itself through vertical integration, stable customer relationships, product quality certifications, and expansion into emerging EV and green energy markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the group reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.934 billion, a 10% decline from the previous year, with a net loss after tax of NT$222 million. The company is mid-sized with total assets around NT$5.09 billion and equity of about NT$1.96 billion. Despite recent losses due to lower orders in the new energy sector and increased costs, the company plans to grow by expanding EV and renewable energy product lines and increasing automation to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-frequency, and high-speed digital connection cables tailored for 3C and automotive applications. Its vertical integration ensures stable raw material supply and cost control. The firm offers diversified product specifications and holds numerous patents, enabling it to meet evolving customer needs. Its strategic shift into EV charging and integrated renewable energy systems positions it as a forward-looking supplier aligned with global green energy trends.
